literature_challenge: Planning and early project phases are under-represented in research infrastructure; systems start at data
management_need: Explicit plan-of-record that evolves with the project
derived_requirement: Structured capture of research phases, objectives, milestones and roadmap

requirement_name: Research question formulation and refinement tracking
literature_challenge: Idea generation and research-question refinement are rarely supported or documented
management_need: Traceable evolution of the research question
derived_requirement: Explicit versioned research questions linked to methods, analyses and outputs

literature_challenge: Upstream intellectual decisions are not captured by provenance tools, which focus on data and computation
management_need: Reconstructable history of why choices were made
derived_requirement: Decision records with rationale, date, participants and links to affected artifacts

requirement_name: Task management across the research lifecycle
literature_challenge: Post-award management and coordination rely on ad hoc scripts and spreadsheets
management_need: Trackable, assignable units of research work
derived_requirement: Definable tasks with status, assignment, priority and dependencies across all stages

requirement_name: Structured documentation and metadata from early stages
literature_challenge: Scripts and workflows are poorly documented; documentation is deferred to dissemination
management_need: Persistent context that survives staff turnover and time
derived_requirement: Version-controlled documentation and metadata created from project start

literature_challenge: Informal coordination is invisible; individual contributions are not attributed
derived_requirement: Mechanisms for contribution tracking, review, feedback and discussion

literature_challenge: Multisite and collaborative work is hard to align
management_need: Shared visibility of who is doing what
derived_requirement: Coordination, progress monitoring and communication linked to research activities

requirement_name: Version control of all research artifacts
literature_challenge: Data standards, analyses and manuscripts evolve without traceable versions
management_need: Identifiable versions and change tracking for every artifact type
derived_requirement: History, diffing and restoration for data, code, documentation and text, not only code

requirement_name: Integration across heterogeneous tools and artifacts
literature_challenge: Fragmented tools and custom scripts break continuity between stages
derived_requirement: A coordination layer that connects heterogeneous tools and artifacts

requirement_name: Granular, scalable provenance capture and retrieval
literature_challenge: Provenance coverage is incomplete and heterogeneous
derived_requirement: Capture and retrieval of the chain question -> method -> data -> analysis -> result -> output

literature_challenge: Papers, tools, data and code are disconnected
derived_requirement: Explicit links assembling related artifacts into one navigable object

requirement_name: Transparency and project visibility to third parties
literature_challenge: The research process is opaque; many studies are descriptive or self-reported
derived_requirement: Visible project status, accessible artifacts and traceable changes for outsiders

literature_challenge: Interoperability, FAIRness and reproducibility are treated as design ideals, not demonstrated end to end
management_need: Preserved information sufficient to re-run the work
derived_requirement: Documentation and preservation of the information needed for reproduction (not a guarantee)

requirement_name: Automation of validation and repetitive checks
literature_challenge: Manual, inconsistent testing and metadata validation
derived_requirement: Automated validation, testing, documentation and artifact-generation workflows

requirement_name: Machine-readable standards, PIDs and interoperable metadata
literature_challenge: Systems and metadata standards are incompatible
derived_requirement: Adoption of machine-readable standards, persistent identifiers and interoperable metadata

requirement_name: Research output management and persistent identification
literature_challenge: Outputs are not linked to the activities that produced them
derived_requirement: Identifiable citable research versions (releases) linked back to tasks and decisions

requirement_name: Governance, funding and workforce models for maintenance
literature_challenge: Long-term services and financing are weakly addressed
derived_requirement: Governance, funding and workforce models for infrastructure maintenance
